rubric_items.reason: The design uses the existing route, service and repo layers. It adds a shared helper in api/src/lib built on the existing time helpers and uses the existing index. It adds no new endpoint, store or infrastructure. All named symbols are in the module map.

S-1 and S-2 are mapped to components. REQ-1..8 are all known. AC2 equality now holds because the list's dayBounds(from).start..dayBounds(to).end matches the count's bounds. A count of 0 is still a link.

It gives the method and path, the field names and types (noShowsLast30Days integer >= 0, noShowsWindow {from,to} as YYYY-MM-DD), the exact link query string, the window formula and the paging behaviour.

Facts are cited to open-questions Q-01/Q-02, and U-3/Q-03 is tracked. But the camelCase naming rule and the example fields rest on the gate comment, which is not cited. Q-03 also reuses an id whose original question is still unanswered.
Four trade-offs are given, each with a reason: putting the count on the existing GET, extracting the rule instead of rewriting it, returning the window from the server, and no cache.
The structure is clear and the names match between the front matter and the body. The answered and dropped questions are explained.

findings.text: The design says camelCase follows the existing response fields (feePaise, slotMinutes, noShows). No claim or citation backs this. The only source is the tech lead's comment at gate G-escalate-design-a2, and the design does not cite it.

cites.quote: camelCase follows the existing response fields (feePaise, slotMinutes, noShows)
Use camelCase response fields (e.g. noShowsLast30Days, noShowsWindow {from,to} as local days), matching feePaise/slotMinutes

findings.suggested_fix: Add a claim for the naming rule that cites approvals.md#g-escalate-design-a2.

findings.text: The design's Q-03 uses the same id as open-questions Q-03 but asks a different question (fromDoctor/PATCH filtering). The original Q-03 asked whether the count goes on GET /api/doctors/:id or a separate read, and it is still unanswered. The design takes option A without recording that.

cites.quote: Should the 30-day No-show count be added to the GET /api/doctors/:id response
Does DoctorFormPage.fromDoctor map only named editable fields
Count on GET /api/doctors/:id instead of a new endpoint

findings.suggested_fix: State that option A of the original Q-03 is taken as the default, and give the narrowed follow-up question its own id or note that it changes Q-03.
